scope: Read-only audit of frozen evidence and committed source blobs. Blind-review and annotation artifacts were not read; tests and Unity were not executed; no provider call or credential read was made.

units.textLength: Unicode code points, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes reported separately; only displayed texts enter length statistics.
units.latency: Proxy elapsed time covers transport and protocol validation; Unity elapsed time covers HTTP request and host evaluation. p95 uses nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n).
units.inputBytes: rawRequestUtf8Bytes measures Unity HTTP JSON; providerUserContextUtf8Bytes reconstructs frozen ProxyService json.dumps(... ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), including default spaces.
units.historyNormalization: Replace only each sample worldRunId, decisionId and meetingId with fixed placeholders throughout string values, including facts referencing meetingId; retain expression.mode and every non-identity field.
units.withinRunNormalization: Recompute sorted compact UTF-8 JSON after deleting only expression.mode.

limitations: This audit checks accounting and recorded host acceptance, not factual correctness, completeness of answers or blind labels. All displayed counts must remain separate from semantic scoring.

The fixed fixture creates eight independent world, economy and meeting instances once, captures eight immutable requests, then makes six preregistered F/S repeated samples per case; 48 requests do not mean 48 independent worlds.
The fixture supplies arrived presence and controlled actor/partner positions. The stock case explicitly mutates inventory. This is not a moving-world or resource-conservation experiment.

The fixed S probe parses with no typed request, then explicitly checks outer version, allowed operation and meeting binding and invokes NpcFactSpeech with the original observation. It does not execute the full production scheduler consumption and freshness lifecycle. The probe source is unchanged between runs.
No replacement or retry appears in the 48 preregistered sample slots or recorded provider transport invocations. Provider-internal processing is outside these local logs.

Manifest plannedTotalCallCeiling 96 is reusable runner capacity; study.json and the plan restrict this run to fixed 48. This audit checks the named fixed evidence directory, not all possible external account activity.

Historical input values match after ephemeral identity substitution, but provider tokenization can differ with the new IDs. Prompt token deltas are measured rather than inferred from the 404-byte S change.
There is no simultaneous old-S arm. These samples do not isolate sole causality or establish long-term zero version errors.

conclusion.summary: The supplied fixed evidence accounts for all 48 preregistered samples, one recorded provider attempt per sample, with no replacement requests. Both arms produced 24 action-version-correct, protocol-accepted candidates and recorded host texts. Frozen source and input comparability checks pass; semantic labels were not inspected.
